name: Thumbnail
description:
A compact preview tile beside a file, a list row or a media item: an image cropped to fill (falling back to a placeholder icon while it loads or when it fails), or a colored tile framing an icon.

  Thumbnail(src: "/photos/summit.jpg", alt: "Mountain peak", size: :xl)
  Thumbnail(variant: :icon_primary) { Icon(:bolt) }
  Thumbnail(size: 56, shape: :circle, src: cover.url)

Sized in em from one `size:` (a preset or pixels), so the tile and its icon scale together. The image variant reuses Avatar's loader (`appica-ui--avatar`), which emits `appica-ui--avatar:loading-status-change` with { status }.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Thumbnail(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Thumbnail(size:, shape:, variant:, src: PHOTO, alt:)
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-end justify-center gap-4") do
    AppicaUI::Thumbnail::SIZES.each_key { |size| Thumbnail(size:, src: PHOTO, alt: "Mountain peak") }
  end
end

examples.name: Custom size
examples.notes: A number is an exact pixel size; everything inside stays proportional.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-end gap-4") do
    [ 40, 56, 88 ].each { |size| Thumbnail(size:, src: PHOTO, alt: "Mountain peak") }
  end
end

examples.name: Shape
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    Thumbnail(size: :xl, shape: :rounded, src: PHOTO, alt: "Mountain peak")
    Thumbnail(size: :xl, shape: :circle, src: PHOTO, alt: "Mountain peak")
  end
end

examples.name: Icon variants
examples.notes: The `icon_*` variants frame an icon instead of an image.

examples.name: Fallback
examples.notes: A missing or failing image shows the placeholder icon - no broken-image glyph.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    Thumbnail(size: :xl, src: "/thumbnail-does-not-exist.jpg", alt: "Unavailable image")
    Thumbnail(size: :xl)
  end
end

examples.name: Media list
examples.code:
phlex do
  ul(class: "divide-border border-border w-full max-w-90 divide-y rounded-xl border") do
    [
      [ -> { Thumbnail(size: :md, src: PHOTO, alt: "Mountain peak") }, "Summit.jpg", "Image · 2.4 MB" ],
      [ -> { Thumbnail(size: :md, variant: :icon_soft) { Icon(:folder) } }, "Field notes", "Folder · 18 items" ],
      [ -> { Thumbnail(size: :md, variant: :icon_primary) { Icon(:music) } }, "Trailhead.mp3", "Audio · 3:42" ],
      [ -> { Thumbnail(size: :md, variant: :icon_secondary) { Icon(:layout_2) } }, "Moodboard", "Album · 24 photos" ]
    ].each do |thumbnail, title, meta|
      li(class: "flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3") do
        instance_exec(&thumbnail)
        div(class: "flex flex-col") do
          span(class: "text-foreground-intense text-sm font-medium") { title }
          span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs") { meta }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "flex items-center gap-3") do
    Thumbnail(size: :md, src: PHOTO, alt: "القمة.jpg")
    div(class: "flex flex-col") do
      span(class: "text-foreground-intense text-sm font-medium") { "القمة.jpg" }
      span(class: "text-foreground-muted text-xs") { "صورة · 2.4 ميغابايت" }
    end
  end
end
